turns.question: I'd love to hear about your coffee routine—so think back to maybe the last week or two, was there a time when you decided to do something different with your coffee than you normally do, whether that was trying a new brand, changing how you made it, or going somewhere different to get it?
turns.response: Honestly, I'm pretty set in my ways with coffee. I just make it at home most mornings the same way—nothing fancy. Though last week I did grab one from that new place near my office instead of making it, mainly because I was running late and didn't have time. It was fine, but like... not really different enough to make me think about switching or anything.

turns.question: What would that café coffee have needed to be like for you to actually consider going back?
turns.response: Honestly, it probably would've just needed to be better coffee. Like, I'm not picky about it, but if it actually tasted good I'd go back regardless of the vibe or whatever. That's kind of the whole point isn't it.

turns.question: Why does having that routine where you don't have to think matter so much to you?
turns.response: Honestly, it's just less friction in the morning. Like, if I have to decide what to do or where to go, that's mental energy I don't have yet. With the routine locked in, I just... move through it.
